testcase.name: a cvar with no value describes itself; with a value it sets and confirms
a spec without a handler refuses execution (the client's forward-only copy)
an unknown name yields null so the caller decides between forward and refusal
a handler throwing unchecked becomes an error result, never a crash of the caller
an under-levelled caller gets the typo response, not a permission explanation
a known command runs with coerced arguments
a command and a cvar sharing one name cannot be constructed
a parse failure carries the message and the generated usage line
